scope: Isolated French catalogue preparation environment and read-only shared torch package; no Android dependencies
pipRemediation: Only private .tools/m1-labels-fr/.venv updated from pip25.0.1 to pip26.2.2; removed 12 initial advisory records including aliases. No modification to earlier ML venv.

findings.reason: Advisory describes attacker config selecting remote attention kernels through AutoModelForCausalLM. This job uses explicit MarianMTModel with eager attention, hash-verified pinned config/model files, offline mode and local_files_only; no attacker model repository is accepted.

Advisory concerns Trainer._load_rng_state and torch below 2.6. This job has torch2.14.1+cpu, never constructs Trainer, never reads rng_state.pth and loads selected model weights only from safetensors.

Advisory concerns LightGlue nested AutoConfig/AutoModel trust handling. This job constructs MarianMTModel/MarianTokenizer explicitly, never LightGlue/AutoModel, with trust_remote_code=False and hash-verified files.

Advisory concerns remote custom generation download before consent. This job never calls load_custom_generate, pins generation_config.json without custom_generate, uses local_files_only and offline environment flags; no custom Python files are loaded.

Advisory concerns tokenizer/processor save_pretrained path traversal through chat_template keys. This job never calls save_pretrained, uses MarianTokenizer with a hash-verified tokenizer config, and has no chat_template/processor pipeline.

CVE-2025-14929 concerns X-CLIP checkpoint conversion and deserialization of attacker-provided conversion checkpoints. This preparation does not import or run X-CLIP conversion scripts; the selected Big Marian model is loaded only from the SHA-verified safetensors file. Earlier rejected small trial used a pinned public Marian checkpoint, not X-CLIP conversion.
